title: Converg. and Special Support Program, Sustainable Infra. Projs. Alleviating Gaps, Access Roads And/or Bridges From the Natl. Roads Leading to Major/ Strat. Public Bldgs./facilities, Const. of Road…
description: CONVERG. AND SPECIAL SUPPORT PROGRAM-SUSTAINABLE INFRA. PROJS. ALLEVIATING GAPS (SIPAG)-SIPAG-ACCESS ROADS AND/OR BRIDGES FROM THE NATL. ROADS LEADING TO MAJOR/ STRAT. PUBLIC BLDGS./FACILITIES-CONST. OF ROAD, PHASE IV, SITIO TALAMSI I-SITIO KAMBUBUYUGAN,
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

reasons.title: Total budget above 95% of similar works (length not stated)
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱144.7M; the 95th percentile for Access / tourism road is ₱120.6M (1064 past contracts).
reasons.evidence: Used only when the length cannot be read; a weak sign.
checks: Find the length or quantities in the bid documents and compute the price per km.
Check whether the scope (several roads, bridges, drainage) explains the size.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 8 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.
